description: NaLuGeO₄ is Hausmannite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent LuO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent LuO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 61-66°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.54 Å. Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LuO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-66°. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.17-2.31 Å. Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent LuO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one LuO₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 43-64°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.74-1.81 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one Ge atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two equivalent Lu, and one Ge atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one Ge atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂LuGe tetrahedra.
